description: Historical price, market cap, and volume in exact point pages (100 per series by default, cap 250). Recent mode accepts up to 365 days; range accepts Unix-second from/to. Choose auto, daily, or hourly interval subject to upstream availability. Cadence is measured from returned timestamps. Subsequent pages refetch upstream data and may shift. Resolve coin slugs with coingecko_search_coins. Chart timestamps are milliseconds.

anyOf.description: Number of days back from now, up to 365.
Alias for the 365-day keyless/Demo history window.

days.description: recent mode: 1–365 days back, or "max" as an alias for 365. Required when mode=recent.

from.description: range mode: start time as a Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Required when mode=range.

id.description: CoinGecko slug (e.g. "bitcoin"). Not a ticker — resolve with coingecko_search_coins.

interval.description: Observation interval; auto preserves CoinGecko defaults. Explicit availability depends on the upstream tier/window.

mode.description: recent: last N days (use days). range: explicit window (use from and to as Unix seconds).

point_limit.description: Points per series; requests above 250 use 250 with a notice.

point_offset.description: Zero-based index into each original series; use nextPointOffset to continue.

to.description: range mode: end time as a Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Required when mode=range.

vs_currency.description: Currency to denominate the series in. Single currency; defaults to "usd".

name: coingecko_get_market_chart

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coin_not_found`: Upstream returned 404 for the slug — it is not a recognized CoinGecko id. `invalid_range`: Range mode lacks from/to, from exceeds to, or recent mode lacks days. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_invalid_params`: CoinGecko rejected the request parameters with HTTP 400. `upstream_validation_failed`: CoinGecko rejected request validation with HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 401, including credential or historical-window restrictions. `upstream_forbidden`: CoinGecko denied access with HTTP 402 or 403. `upstream_not_found`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 on an endpoint without a domain-specific missing result. `upstream_invalid_request`: CoinGecko rejected the HTTP request with another permanent client status or redirect. `upstream_conflict`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 409, 423, or 424. `upstream_timeout`: A CoinGecko attempt timed out or returned HTTP 408, 425, or 504. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The coin-detail request, conditional currency lookup, and their retries exceeded one 50-second deadline. `upstream_deadline`: An externally supplied deadline expired during the CoinGecko exchange. `upstream_http_error`: CoinGecko returned permanent HTTP 501 Not Implemented. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a transient 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

granularity.description: Observed cadence of the complete original price series; unknown with fewer than two observations.

id.description: CoinGecko slug the series is for.

marketCaps.description: Market-cap series over the same window.

t.description: Timestamp in Unix MILLISECONDS (note: /simple/price uses seconds).

value.description: Value at this timestamp (price, market cap, or volume in vs_currency).

nextPointOffset.description: Next index when any original series has more points.

notice.description: Refetch semantics, applied caps, history aliases, and empty-page guidance.

observedIntervalInMs.description: Median positive adjacent timestamp spacing in milliseconds, when measurable.

prices.description: Price series. Data provided by CoinGecko.

t.description: Timestamp in Unix MILLISECONDS (note: /simple/price uses seconds).

value.description: Value at this timestamp (price, market cap, or volume in vs_currency).

totalCount.description: Largest original series count before point pagination.

volumes.description: Volume series over the same window.
